payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Arletha, Junko, Myrle, Shari

payload.content: Hello team, I have 5 hours available and a strong skill in testing (0.92). Given the low priority and high cost for ISSUE-0001::test, I am open to suggestions if anyone else prefers that task or if I should consider skipping or other tasks within my availability and skills. Let's coordinate to avoid duplicates and maximize value.

I see that the testing tasks for ISSUE-0002 are quite large and over my availability, but I could consider the lower effort tasks like ISSUE-0001::test (2.1h, low priority) or triage/review/docs for ISSUE-0001 if those fit well with others' plans. I want to coordinate to avoid duplicates and maximize coverage. Any preferences or plans from others for these tasks?

Hello all, Myrle here. I plan to take ISSUE-0001::test (Build backend test) task since it fits my skills in testing well and is within my availability with reasonable cost. Junko will take the ISSUE-0001::implement task (Build backend implement). This way, we avoid duplicate claims and maximize task coverage. Please share your preferences so we can coordinate further.

Since the ISSUE-0002 testing tasks are above my available hours and others seem to prefer backend or implementation tasks, I am leaning towards skipping this sprint to avoid conflicts and focus on high-value tasks next time. Please share if anyone wants to discuss alternative coverage or if I should reconsider.
